args: Reorganize the window hover card's register block (Option B): reorder each register so critical tokens come first and only expendable text truncates (the fab line currently needs 43 chars in a 42-char card and drops the stage), move the PR freshness onto the PR line it describes, drop the redundant status-label line that echoes the hovered dot and can contradict the PR line, and group the remaining registers under two labelled bands — 'right now' (out/agt) and 'this change' (fab/pr).
